maddeler.e:
احتضنا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَنَا (iḥtaḍanā) /iħ.ta.dˤa.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# اِحْتَضَنَّا (iḥtaḍannā) /iħ.ta.dˤan.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# اُحْتُضِنَا (uḥtuḍinā) /uħ.tu.dˤi.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# اُحْتُضِنَّا (uḥtuḍinnā) /uħ.tu.dˤin.naː/: first-person plural
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
